description: Registration of municipal fisherfolk, motorized fishing vessels (3 gross tons and below), and coastal aquaculture operators in Roxas City under the City Agriculture Office.
steps: Secure registration forms at the City Agriculture Office (Fisheries Section), City Hall Compound.
Submit vessel specifications or aquaculture lease location details (fishponds, oyster/mussel beds in Sibuyan Sea estuaries).
Undergo vessel inspection and engine verification by City Coastal Law Enforcement officers.
Receive official Municipal Fisherfolk ID and BoatR vessel registration plates.
requirements: Barangay Certification of residency in a coastal barangay (Baybay, Culasi, Libas, Barra, etc.)
Vessel admeasurement certificate from authorized City Fishery Technician

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Municipal fisherfolk and coastal fishpond/aquaculture operators in Roxas City

sources.name: Roxas City Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Council (CFARMC)

service: Agricultural Crop Support & Farm Inputs Distribution
description: Distribution of certified high-yield palay seeds, organic bio-fertilizers, and farm machinery assistance for agrarian communities in Roxas City.
steps: Verify enrollment in the Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture (RSBSA).
Proceed to the City Agriculture Office during scheduled cropping season distribution.
Claim allocated certified seeds and bio-fertilizer vouchers.
requirements: Barangay Certification confirming active cultivation of agricultural land in Roxas City

sources.name: Department of Agriculture Region VI / Roxas City Agriculture Office
